content: Auto-battler genre (Wikipedia; design codex; dev frameworks) core: prep phase (buy/place/synergy-build) then automatic combat resolution the player watches. Canonical systems: units with hp/attack/defense/speed/ability/traits/star-level/items; trait synergies with breakpoints; economy (gold, interest, reroll, XP/level cost, buy/sell, shop lock); positioning that provably matters; round structure with win/loss; unit combining/upgrades. Design pitfalls: dominant comp (one synergy always wins), economy with no tension, and combat you must watch but cannot read. For a physics spectator game the synergy/economy layer is out of scope v1, but the legibility and counter-design lessons transfer directly.
